svg.title: Useful output over the mission
svg.desc: Mean daily useful output of three redundancy policies across 10,000 simulated missions. Fixed TMR stops once fewer than two processors survive. Standby simplex runs at half rate for the whole life. The shrinking quorum matches TMR while it can vote, then keeps going at half rate on one processor.
svg.text: Mean over 10,000 simulated missions. 100% is a full voting set working every day.
The shaded area under the shrinking quorum is its total useful work.
